ModMetaData.name: 残骸图谱 Salvage Atlas
ModMetaData.author: SalvageAtlas
ModMetaData.description:
残骸图谱 Salvage Atlas — reverse-engineer mechanoid wrecks for data fragments (not research points). Analyze at a salvage bench, then spend progress on bounded atlas ranks: one-shot schematics, short personal field patches, and risky teardown recipes. Failed teardowns waste fragments and may spark a small fire/blast with a letter. Idle without mechs. Settings + easy mode.
Playability first: player verbs, readable failure, no permanent +20% global damage tree.
